# PlayTheory

> PlayTheory (playtheoryhq.com, also called PlayTheory HQ) is a free website of two-player strategy games that run in the browser. The games available now are DuSoKu, a two-player sudoku, and Amazons, a board game of moving queens and flaming arrows. Random mode deals one game after another at random and keeps score across the run. No sign-up and nothing to install.

## DuSoKu

- Both players fill in the same sudoku puzzle. Each correct number scores points; numbers with more copies left to place are worth more.
- Each puzzle has four ×3 and eight ×2 bonus squares. A wrong number costs 1 point.
- The higher score wins when the board is full or the clock runs out. Games last at most 12 minutes.
- Play side by side on one screen, or online: send a friend a challenge link or a 5-letter room code.
- Works on phones, tablets and computers in any modern browser.

## Amazons

- Each player has two amazons that move like chess queens, then shoot an arrow that burns a square. Whoever makes the last move wins.
- A small 5×5 or 6×6 board. Each player has 4 minutes on a chess clock and at most 20 seconds a move; take longer and the turn passes, run out of time and you lose.
- Play on one screen or online with a link or room code. Online games between signed-in players are rated.

- [Play DuSoKu](https://playtheoryhq.com/): the game itself
- [DuSoKu rules and FAQ](https://playtheoryhq.com/duo-sudoku/): how two-player sudoku works
- [Games like chess](https://playtheoryhq.com/games-like-chess/): two-player strategy games with no luck and nothing hidden
